issues.on_page: Local Receipts: Other, Sewer Fund 17,445.00 / Water Fund 28,588.24
issues.issue: These are the only receipts of the Sewer and Water funds, so they are almost certainly utility collections. Under the user's 2026-10-28 rule that is category Utility Charges, not charges for services/fees. Applies to receipts[10] and receipts[11]. The printed label is only 'Other', so this remains an assumption.

issues.on_page: Solid Waste 14,466.75 (line 45, under Business-Type Activities, General Fund column)
issues.issue: The form lists Solid Waste under business-type activities, but it was paid from the General Fund column. Keeping it governmental (category utilities) keeps the General Fund roll-forward intact and is defensible; the line is already marked review.
